description: Ministry of Finance -  Service Minute of  the Sri Lanka Valuation Service
reasoning: This gazette content pertains to the Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Valuation Service, detailing public service recruitment, grades, salaries, and service conditions. It is issued by the Public Service Commission, which is the central body for public administration, making it a clear example of a Public Service Gazette (Type 8). The content does not involve government structural changes, specific personnel appointments with portfolios, or any of the other specialized categories like land, legal, or commercial matters.
